purpose: Budget signals, reliable <=15% reserve and destination-independent preparation.
use: Context or compute budget is running low, or work may be interrupted: keep the reserve and prepare destination-independent continuation.
semantic_conditions: Use the 15% reserve only with reliable comparable measurements; never invent percentages.
mandatory_preconditions: Reliable budget signal and current work state.
postconditions_verification: Continuation material prepared before the reserve is exhausted.
